relations.description: Tarver and Salome have a conversation about his indigestion and battle readiness.
relations.evidence_quote: SALOME. Major! TARVER. [_With a gasp._] Oh! SALOME. Not well again? TARVER. Indigestion. I'm always like this after dinner.
